scope: Selected 195 pairs: 181 prior pairs plus fourteen B11 instance and image write rows. 193 are complete under reviewed completion records (native wait, events, exec, seven B01 mutations, conditional instance PATCH, all twenty B02 inspection rows, 51 B09 network rows, all forty B10 administrative rows, all 24 B05 PATCH rows, 28 stream-free B08 storage rows and all nineteen stream-free B11 rows); every other whole endpoint remains partial. Full classification is separate. No automatic tool export or acceptance claim.acceptance claim.
evidence_kind: Existing differential/independent fixture test source anchors; links do not themselves prove behavior. Canonical check runs the actual tests.

rest_typed: typed PATCH preserves field presence, routing, If-Match and native errors
patch_failures: dispatched PATCH failures stay uncertain without replay or invented identity
patch_lifetime: dispatched PATCH deadline and cancellation close the peer and remain uncertain
patch_preflight: conditional PATCH preflight rejects invalid input without I/O
mutation_cancellation: B01 cancellation permission races rejection and response loss
inspection_contract: scoped inspection matches native results, routing and errors
extensions: every method rejects unavailable extensions before dispatch
errors: native failures retain separate HTTP/native codes and never replay any method
restore: snapshot restore retains acceptance and conditional extensions stop incompatible mutations
discovery: discovery preserves optional/null/unknown fields and rejects missing extensions
discovery_native: native connection information and authenticated header requirement stay explicit
native_wait: native wait gated snapshots, errors and EOF agree with the pinned client
native_wait_lifetime: native wait stalled body obeys deadline, cancellation and caller loss
native_wait_preflight: native wait rejects unbounded timeout and pre-canceled contexts before I/O
poll_wait: accepted handles retain backend/identity binding and waiting observes authoritative completion
cancel: supported cancellation is one native request; completion race preserves native data
local_cancel: local operation wait cancellation preserves the accepted snapshot and never sends DELETE
failed: an already failed operation returns its native error, as natively
exec_native: actual native noninteractive IO and exit status match over
exec_bounds: limits and rejected/raising sinks retain acceptance and close all channels
exec_lifetime: run lifetime includes submission and negotiation with truthful retained acceptance
exec_stdin: interrupts a confirmed blocked stdin write
websocket: exec/console negotiate native input/output/control and retain authoritative exit status
core_inspection_contract: scoped inspection matches native results, routing and errors
receive_expiry: socket receive expiry retains deadline despite delayed observation
event_selectors: event selector upgrade targets and Event fields agree with the pinned client
event_rejection: native event upgrade rejection agrees with the pinned client
event_preflight: subscription options are validated before any upgrade
event_listener: handler registration/removal, native callback data and repeatable wait match pinned listener
event_filters: filters, capacity and targets are isolated between explicit listeners
event_wait: local wait timeout leaves a live subscription active and sends no backend cancellation
event_callback_failure: callback exceptions are redacted and release the socket, without damaging another listener
event_callback_timeout: blocked callback is killed within its budget and result remains repeatable
event_termination: native EOF, malformed events and lifetime terminate the local listener
event_owner_loss: owner loss kills an active callback and raw process calls cannot bypass owner binding
event_listener_loss: brutal listener loss kills even a callback trapping exits
event_tail: queued final events are delivered before native EOF completes the listener
event_bounds: context cancellation and inbound byte bounds end the listener and close the peer
event_caller_loss: caller loss closes an event listener blocked in
event_send: official SendEvent and explicit channel send agree on native JSON text frames
event_send_limits: invalid events send nothing and frame overflow closes only the selected channel
event_send_owner: owner death releases the listener and subsequent sends report closure
exec_modes: ExecInstance modes agree with the pinned client
exec_guards: exec extension guards reject before dispatch like the pinned client
exec_rejection: native exec rejection agrees with the pinned client through exec and run
exec_channels: channel negotiation and metadata failures retain acceptance and close opened peers
exec_status: pending exit status, missing channels and Inspect redaction
exec_preflight: run preflight rejects mode, sinks, options and input limits without POST
exec_chunking: run chunks stdin to the smaller response frame limit
exec_drain: run drains both outputs while stdin is blocked and waits for the input barrier
exec_sink_lifetime: run local timeout and host cancellation kill stalled sinks and retain a reusable handle
exec_owner: run owner loss terminates the sink and all peers without DELETE
exec_collect_owner: owner loss kills an exit-trapping sink and all channels without remote cancellation
exec_completion: output barriers cannot substitute for final operation or valid exit metadata
exec_callback: a stalled callback is bounded and killed, including exit trapping
exec_collector: foreign creator and malformed options reject without touching channels
exec_concurrency: stderr progresses while stdout is stalled; exact aggregate limit succeeds
exec_close: normal close, malformed barrier and abrupt disconnect have distinct outcomes
exec_upgrade_lifetime: during a channel upgrade keeps its kind and acceptance
exec_context_channels: collection reports a request context that stopped its channels first
rest_root: scoped inspection matches native results, routing and errors
sync_mutation: synchronous write matches native request, result and rejection
peer_guard: non-local network peers require network_integrations before dispatch
storage_guards: guarded storage fields reject before dispatch
rest_storage_reads: scoped inspection matches native results, routing and errors
rest_patch: conditional PATCH matches native request, field presence and result
patch_contract_failures: dispatched PATCH failures stay uncertain without replay
patch_contract_lifetime: dispatched PATCH deadline and cancellation close the peer
patch_contract_preflight: conditional PATCH preflight rejects invalid input without I/O
async_write: asynchronous write matches native request, operation and wait
admin_guards: guarded administrative fields reject before dispatch
trust_bootstrap: untrusted clients bootstrap trust with a trust token
mutation_bodies: B01 every body field and action agrees with the pinned client
mutation_guards: B01 guarded fields require their extensions before dispatch

entries.scope: Native ExecInstance submission in collected noninteractive, non-waiting, interactive PTY and record-output modes, with user/group/cwd and terminal size, compared with the unchanged pinned client over Unix and verified mutual HTTPS.
